_comment: Offline fixture for `node index.js --from-fixture fixture.sample.json --dry-run`. Keys mirror the Matrix client-server endpoints this plugin calls: whoami = GET /_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami, m.direct = GET /_matrix/client/v3/user/{me}/account_data/m.direct, profiles = GET /_matrix/client/v3/profile/{userId}, presence = GET /_matrix/client/v3/presence/{userId}/status. A presence entry carrying `_status` models the homeserver REFUSING that call (403/404), which is what a presence-disabled server does. Covers online, unavailable+status_msg, offline+status_msg, a refused presence, a note-to-self DM (ignored), and a stale m.direct entry with no rooms (ignored).

@quiet:matrix.example.error: Presence is not activated on this homeserver
